_readme.zh: 厂商表：顺序＝表 2-1 分组顺序＝图 3-x 图例顺序。group＝主分组（图例按它分组），tags＝筛选标签（顶栏「前沿 / 大厂 / 开源」筛选器；一家可以有多个，如 Google＝前沿＋大厂）。颜色（2026-11-22 第三版，官方品牌色系）：规则是「官方色优先，撞了取官方辅色，最后才派生」，每家只从 research/2026-11-22-brand-colors.json 里自己的官方色（公司主色 / 辅色 / 产品主色 / 产品辅色）选，组合搜索让 8 家两两最差的一对尽量大；color_src 写每个颜色的出处类型，derived=true 表示非官方派生色（现在是 xAI、智谱两家）。仍然撞色的对靠图里每行的「品牌色小方块 + 名字」区分，见 qa/palette_report.txt。全部 8 家的颜色都由 build_tables.py 写进 <style id="data-css">（前沿三家同时也写在报告原 CSS 里，两处必须一致）。改颜色后跑 qa/palette_check.py。
_readme.en: Vendor table: order = Table 2-1 group order = Fig 3-x legend order. group = primary group (legends group by it); tags = filter tags for the top-bar Frontier / Big Tech / Open-weight filter (a vendor can have several, e.g. Google = frontier + Big Tech). Colors (third version, 2026-11-22, official brand palettes): the rule is "official colors first, an official secondary when they collide, a derived color only as a last resort". Each vendor picks only from its own official colors in research/2026-11-22-brand-colors.json (company primary / secondary, product primary / secondary), and a combinatorial search maximizes the worst pair among the 8. color_src records where each color comes from; derived=true marks a non-official derived color (currently xAI and Zhipu). Pairs that still collide are told apart by the "brand swatch + name" on every row; see qa/palette_report.txt. build_tables.py writes all 8 vendors' colors into <style id="data-css"> (the three frontier colors also sit in the report's own CSS; the two must match). Run qa/palette_check.py after changing colors.
